entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I need to... I think I need to return something? It's all very confusing. I bought a helmet.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh, um, a preference? I guess? I just... the color wasn't what I thought it would be from the website. It's still in the original packaging, the box is unopened and everything. I'm just so overwhelmed by the whole process. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can help. It's no problem at all. Let me just pull up your order details. Can I get your order number or the email address you used?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the Urban Commuter Helmet, ordered about a month ago. I see it was delivered 38 days ago.
Is that bad? The policy pages were so hard to follow. I didn't know what to do.

Not at all. I'm checking our policy right now, and you're well within the 90-day return window for standard items. We want to ensure you're completely satisfied, especially with a piece of equipment related to your safety.
Oh, really? So I can send it back? That's such a relief.

Absolutely. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to your email now. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the helmet, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's perfect. Thank you so much for making that easy, David.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
